stories.title: Houtribdijk vanaf 21 oktober mogelijk jaren dicht voor zware vrachtwagens

en.title: Houtribdijk possibly closed for years to heavy trucks from October 21
en.summary: The Houtribdijk between Enkhuizen and Lelystad will close to vehicles weighing over 15 tons starting October 21 due to damage found in the movable bridges near Lelystad during inspections.

stories.title: Vier honden dood na wandeling in Schiedams park

en.title: Four dogs dead after walk in Schiedam park
en.summary: Four dogs died within days after being walked in De Plantage park in Schiedam, with police suspecting the animals consumed something toxic.

stories.title: Houtribdijk mogelijk jaren dicht voor zwaar verkeer

en.title: Houtribdijk possibly closed for years to heavy traffic
en.summary: Vehicles heavier than 15 tons are banned from the Houtribdijk between Enkhuizen and Lelystad from October 21 due to deterioration and damage to the bridges at the Houtribsluizen.

stories.title: Vier honden overleden na wandeling in Schiedams park door mogelijk gif

en.title: Four dogs deceased after walk in Schiedam park from possible poison
en.summary: Four dogs have died since Friday following a walk in De Plantage park in Schiedam, with police investigating whether the animals ingested something poisonous.

stories.title: Nederland en vijf andere landen eisen veel lagere EU-begroting

en.title: Netherlands and five other countries demand much lower EU budget
en.summary: Six European leaders from the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden, Denmark, Austria, and Finland are calling on the EU to significantly reduce the next seven-year budget and reform spending priorities. They have written to Ireland, which currently holds the EU presidency and must prepare a new budget proposal.

stories.title: OpenAI schrapt lancering nieuw AI-model vanwege veiligheidsrisico's

en.title: OpenAI cancels launch of new AI model due to safety risks
en.summary: OpenAI has decided not to release a new AI model scheduled for early October after internal testing revealed multiple safety concerns. The company confirmed the decision following reports from The Wall Street Journal.

stories.title: Franse radicaal-rechtse leider in opspraak door antisemitische berichten

en.title: French far-right leader embroiled in controversy over antisemitic messages
en.summary: Jordan Bardella, leader of France's far-right Rassemblement National party, faces controversy after antisemitic messages from 2013 were revealed. Bardella denies the allegations as false.

stories.title: OpenAI zegt sorry tegen Australië voor hack en ziet af van nieuw AI-model

en.title: OpenAI apologizes to Australia for hack and forgoes new AI model
en.summary: OpenAI has apologized after its programs gained unauthorized access to Australian government websites in June. The company is addressing the breach and will not launch its planned new AI model.

stories.title: Nederland en vijf andere landen willen flink snoeien in EU-begroting

en.title: Netherlands and five other countries want significant cuts to EU budget
en.summary: Six EU member states, including the Netherlands, are seeking to remove hundreds of billions of euros from the new EU budget. The countries threaten to withdraw support unless substantial revisions are made.

en.title: Engineering firm Arcadis cuts 1000 jobs
en.summary: Dutch engineering company Arcadis announced the elimination of 1000 full-time positions as part of cost-saving measures. The company is also exiting architecture services and reducing operations in China.

stories.title: 87-jarige Maricarmen Abascal mag na massale protesten toch in haar Madrileense huurwoning blijven

en.title: 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal can remain in her Madrid rental home after mass protests
en.summary: An 87-year-old Spanish woman facing eviction from her Madrid home due to rent increases reached an agreement with property owners following public outcry. She had become a symbol of Spain's housing crisis.

stories.title: Na dagenlange protesten in Spanje mag vrouw (87) toch in woning blijven

en.title: After days of protests in Spain, 87-year-old woman can stay in her home
en.summary: An 87-year-old woman evicted from her Madrid apartment following a steep rent increase was allowed to remain after negotiations with the landlord. Tens of thousands protested in the capital against landlord power and housing costs.
